Tobias, the depot was Southgate. I've posted that as a reply to your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

It comes from that channel's history. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, once Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address for the Southgate site in anything you have access to, so check that with Priyanka before the call if you need it.
